lines.text: Jesus asked who would not pull a son or ox from a pit on the Sabbath; none could answer.
Jesus taught guests at a Passover feast to sit in the last place so the host would move them up.
Jesus told him to invite the poor, the crippled, the lame and the blind and be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.
The angry master sent his servant to the temple courts to bring in the poor, crippled, blind and lame.
